history.name: What is no longer available, said in place
history.description: A feature withdrawn during the cycle is listed at the end of its own area, with the reason it went, rather than simply vanishing from the list. A reader looking for something they remember finds the answer where they were looking for the feature.
history.dev_notes: The per-category removed trailer in MarkdownRenderer#category(); it steps up to the sub-section heading level when the area has sub-sections, so it can't read as a footnote to the last one.
